newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Wah Lee offers 70 mln shrs at HK$1.00 each.
newsitem.headline: HK's Wah Lee offers 70 mln shrs at HK$1.00 each.

text.p: Air conditoning systems, audio visual and photographic products distributor Wah Lee Resources Holdings Ltd said on Monday it would offer 70 million new shares at HK$1.00 each in an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong.
A warrant will be attached for every five shares subscribed, it said.
The IPO runs from December 31 to January 6 and dealing in the company shares is expected to begin on January 17.
Net proceeds of HK$59.5 million will be used to promote products, set up product display showrooms across China, buy a warehouse in Hong Kong and for working capital.
The new issue is sponsored and managed by Lippo Securities Ltd. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
